products.name: 4K IP Vandal Dome Camera
products.summary: Rugged 4K dome for outdoor and high-traffic areas with strong night vision.
products.description: The ST-4K-D30 is a commercial-grade IP vandal dome designed for reliable surveillance in demanding environments. It delivers 4K resolution for clear identification, infrared night vision up to 30 metres, and an IP67-rated housing for weather resistance. Suitable for offices, shops, compounds, and industrial sites.

products.name: 4K IP Bullet Camera
products.summary: Long-range bullet camera for perimeter and parking coverage.
products.description: The ST-4K-B40 bullet camera is built for perimeter walls, driveways, and open yards. 4K detail and extended IR help you cover longer distances with fewer units. Ideal where a dome’s field of view is not enough.

products.name: 20x Optical PTZ Camera
products.summary: Pan-tilt-zoom camera for active monitoring of large sites.
products.description: Control direction and zoom from your NVR or mobile app. The ST-PTZ-20 is suited to warehouses, schools, and multi-building compounds where operators need to follow activity across a wide area.

products.name: Touchless Facial & Card Terminal
products.summary: Fast facial recognition with card fallback for offices and gated entries.
products.description: The ST-AC-800 combines touchless facial recognition with card authentication. Recognition in about 0.2 seconds supports busy entrances. Anti-spoofing dual-camera design reduces false access from photos. Capacity for large user lists makes it practical for growing organisations.

products.name: Fingerprint Access Reader
products.summary: Reliable fingerprint reader for doors and staff attendance.
products.description: A practical fingerprint terminal for single doors or small multi-door setups. Use it for access control, time attendance, or both. Simple enrolment and stable recognition for everyday workplace use.

products.name: Wireless Intrusion Alarm Kit
products.summary: Expandable wireless alarm kit for homes and small businesses.
products.description: The ST-ALM-PRO kit gives you a control panel, door/window contacts, and motion detection as a starting point. Add more sensors as your site grows. App alerts help you respond quickly when something is triggered.

products.name: Outdoor Wireless Siren
products.summary: Loud outdoor siren with strobe for visible and audible deterrent.
products.description: Pair with your alarm panel to deter intruders and alert neighbours. Weather-resistant housing suits Ugandan outdoor conditions. Use on walls or under eaves for strong coverage.
